anchor: root collar at local origin; roots extend into negative Blender Z / glTF Y
stage_range_authority: Authored ranges carried forward from the tree reference manifest, not universal biological age-height laws
status: Static placement assets. C++ importer/material/collision/LOD registration remains a separate integration step.
variation: Select species and stage first. Sample target height from its allowed range using stable tree ID and site vigor. Apply uniform scale target_height/nominal_height to the complete asset and collider. Common samples may use the narrower recommended range; rare outliers may use the full authored range. Preserve sampled transform across streaming.
slope_placement: Keep the trunk near gravity-up. Sample actual terrain under collar and root footprint. Roots are a separate mesh with below-ground reach; static roots cannot fit every hillside automatically. Bury collar modestly, deform roots against terrain where supported, or reject unsupported placements. Preserve a small exposed surface-root allowance. Never rotate the complete tall tree to the full ground normal.
lod_policy: Files are alternatives; display only one LOD at a time. Stage and LOD are independent. Use projected screen size and measured budgets; no distances are hardcoded in runtime.

assets.foliage_lod_policy: All sprays retained; LOD1/2 reduce card subdivisions and wood geometry. No random leaf deletion.
